subject: ONE male barn owl, round glasses, always sitting on the floor
props: ONE black top hat, upturned; small coins; ONE thick old book
environment: busy metro underground passage, cream tiles, low arched ceiling, trains thunder by in light streaks beyond a wide wall arch; dense commuter crowd hurrying nonstop: coats, briefcases, suitcases, sneakers; owl by the wall, hat in front; no signs or text
lighting: warm overhead tube light, cold train flashes on tiles
motion_rule: the owl sits but moves his WHOLE body every beat. Running people, coins, trains rush around him. He fills half the frame height, except the three close-up beats where hat, face or book fills the whole frame. Other beats: action across the scene. The camera moves and changes angle and shot size every beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.4; no words 2.05-2.45 and 5.42-5.90; last word by 6.60; no words after 6.6
audio.lip_sync: the owl speaks, beak opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: ya vsyu ZHIZN' so-bi-RAL MUD-rost'. DU-mal, E-ta pa-MO-zhet na-ka-PIT' na PEN-si-yu. a-SHIP-sya
audio.sfx: metro rumble, train roar, footsteps, coin clinks

timeline.a: close-up: he thrusts the upturned hat into the lens, black inside filling the frame; a coin clinks on the brim
he slaps the hat down on the tiles and bounces back; near foreground: running boots stomp by
he jerks sideways, catches a tossed coin with one wing like a goalkeeper
he twists and hurls the coin into the hat; near foreground: sneakers run by; a train roars through the arch
he sways, chest puffed double, feathers bristling; the crowd splits around him
he dives sideways for a thrown coin, misses, it bounces off his glasses
timeline.c: behind the owl, at the crowd

timeline.a: close-up: he lunges into the lens, glasses and beak filling the frame
a running passenger clips him with a suitcase; he spins a full turn on his tail
he recoils, feathers burst, glasses askew; the camera rushes in from the far end of the passage through the crowd to him, stopping at a medium shot
he leans after a coin wobbling away by the hat; near foreground: a running boot kicks it
he swivels his whole body to face us, commuters stream behind him
close-up: a passer-by flings a thick old book, it tumbles into the lens, cover and paper filling the frame
the book drops into the hat, flattening it; the owl recoils and flops back; legs run by
he snatches a tossed coin midair with his beak and swallows it whole like a mouse, throat bulging; legs run by

must_appear: close-ups 0.00 hat, 4.60 face, 8.00 book; coins land in the upturned hat; crowd running every beat
negative_prompt: text, digits, signs, station names, subtitles, zoom, slow push-in, static wide shot, a still crowd, an empty passage, blurred faceless smear, escalator, conveyor, belt, rail cart, the owl walking, the owl running, the owl standing up, a hero running at the camera, a closed beak while speaking, a line said twice, a stuttered word, an inserted word, speech after 6.6, foreign accent, feminine word endings, neuter word endings, a second hat, a glowing emblem, a logo
